metadata.description: The FlowLeap Plugin Marketplace — curated, free-to-install skill packs for patent and IP work.

plugins.name: personas
plugins.description: FlowLeap persona skill pack — patent attorney, IP analyst, researcher, and startup-founder workflows that operate entirely through the FlowLeap CLI / backend facade.

plugins.name: recipes
plugins.description: FlowLeap patent-research recipe pack — end-to-end workflows for prior-art search, freedom-to-operate, patent landscape, claim analysis, patent-to-report, and academic literature review, plus recipe-custom-dashboard: disposable, self-contained HTML dashboards with verified numbers and full data provenance, generated from live patent data by a zero-dependency script. All driven through the FlowLeap CLI / backend facade.

plugins.name: flowleap-tools
plugins.description: FlowLeap CLI tool pack — the flowleap-* skills that teach an agent to drive the FlowLeap CLI and backend facade: authentication, provider keys, EPO/USPTO/OPS patent search, academic and non-patent literature, legal references, citations, and the unified /v1/tools facade.
